_doc: Setting-out / as-built tolerance profiles and monitoring threshold profiles per country (ISO code). Registered at startup through register_pack_tolerance and register_pack_profile, offered only while that country is an active market. Every value names its standard, clause and edition year. status verified means the clause was cited from the published table; to_verify means the value has not yet been checked against the source text and must be confirmed by the user before it is relied on. Values in mm (h_mm radial in plan, v_mm height) and mm/day.
